species.evidence: MS data was analyzed by MaxQuant suite of algorithms version 1.4.1.2 using a Homo Sapiens database downloaded from UniprotKB on the 27th of November 2013 and comprising 88,473 protein isoforms entries.

tissue.evidence: Bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (Lonza, StemCell Technologies) were purchased with their mesenchymal characteristics verified.

cell_type.evidence: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) are multipotent cells with great potential in therapy, reflected by more than 500 MSC-based clinical trials registered with the NIH.

disease_state.evidence: inferred: Details of the BM-MSC donors: 40y/m (StemCell, MSC-001F, lot#BM2893), 39y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#1F3422), 27y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#318006), 20y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#8F3520).

sample_source.evidence: All cells were cultured at 37 °C in an atmosphere supplemented to 5% CO2.
